Module-boundary plan: no eslint.config.mjs edits and no new forbidden sales/pos->expiry or expiry->payroll imports. We implemented consumer-owned synchronous ports, bound only at application composition apps/api/src/expiry-commerce.module.ts (API and worker). Sales hooks/index export EXPIRY_SALE_POSTING; POS expiry-offers.ts/index export POS_EXPIRY_OFFERS; expiry ports/index export EXPIRY_PAYROLL_SOURCE. Pure sale/return/offer facts move to existing shared/expiry. Root ExpirySalePostingAdapter delegates exact tx/actor to ExpiryCommerceService; ExpiryPayrollSourceAdapter delegates exact tx to PayrollSourceDeductionsService. Consumers use required ModuleRef.get(strict:false), never optional/no-op fallback. Async events cannot preserve stock, approval/source allocation and payroll liability rollback/lock ordering in one transaction; these synchronous interfaces retain the existing shared-transaction behavior while leaving table ownership unchanged. No owner's ESLint exception is needed. Independent review APPROVE; cumulative fullApp sales/edge3,commerce/payroll20,race integrity2 passed (25/25) plus4binding/identity/rejection/lockorder unit cases. Exact staged feature checks still required after preceding HR/salary lands.
SQL rewrites prepared:0124 position_legacy_salary is nullable with no ADD default (oldrows NULL); SET DEFAULT false only afterward for future rows. Existing NULL row is legacy, absentrow is not; normal save normalizes retainedlegacy.0127 existing user_notifications table/kindCHECK left completely unchanged: new user_price_notifications sidecar uses existing numeric notification sequence; union pagination before LIMIT, scoped unread/read and dedup. App may insert only user/key/payload, update only read_at; explicitIDs/payloadmutation denied. Sidecar12/12 integration passed incl mixedold/new cursor/read/permissions. No migration-time UPDATE/DELETE existingrows, RENAME, ALTERTYPE, SETNOTNULL, or DROP. Existing-table CHECK additions/triggers and new-column default are listed for explicit review in a one-file review document now being prepared; will push independent in/review-remaining-features and send link. This includes full per-feature paths and SQL text/reasons (not stale original DROP proposal). We do not touch real systems/15433 or original local DBs.
